description:
Wittenborg University of Applied Sciences is a vibrant, double-accredited business school based in Apeldoorn. Wittenborg was founded in 1987. Dutch universities are well-known for their high academic standards and high-quality education. Wittenborg intends to uphold these criteria throughout its programs. It is one of the few 100% English-speaking higher education schools in the Netherlands, and its 1000+ students and staff come from over 100 different countries, making it the Netherlands' most international private University of applied sciences and business school. The school also maintains a thriving study location in Amsterdam, emphasizing Entrepreneurship. Wittenborg's undergraduate and master's programs are internationally recognized and accredited in Europe. It is ranked #176-200 in QS International Trade Ranking 2023. Moreover, Wittenborg University places a high value on leading students to successful jobs. The university's comprehensive career services and support systems are designed to help students find jobs, secure internships, and advance their careers. Students are better equipped with this crucial help to improve their employability and confidently launch their professions after graduation.

For full-time students, a typical bachelor's program at Wittenborg University lasts three years. Depending on the individual topic of study and the curriculum structure, specific programs may vary, such as 3.5 or 4 years. On the other hand, master's programs at Wittenborg University typically last one year for full-time students. This indicates that if you pursue a master's degree full-time, you can usually finish it in 12 months. With international students from over 100 nations studying at WUAS, campus life is global. The student body is close-knit, and you'll be greeted warmly when you arrive. WUAS encourages students to make the most of their university experience by supporting a socially active lifestyle. There are frequent activities, ranging from social mixers to karaoke nights, providing several opportunities to form memories and friendships during your stay at the University. The University also provides housing for your experience. To give more detail, various handy on-campus and off-campus student housing alternatives are available. On-campus housing offers a comfortable and social environment. There will be a furnished room, communal kitchens for fun cooking sessions with your friends, cool lounges to relax in, and even laundry facilities. Living on campus means you'll be surrounded by students worldwide, which is a great way to make long-lasting friendships. They also have off-campus housing options if you prefer to live independently. You can select from flats or shared houses that suit your preferences.

Students' cost of living in the Netherlands, including housing, food, transportation, and other expenses, varies by area. Living in larger cities, such as Amsterdam, may be more expensive than in smaller towns like Apeldoorn. Budgeting for housing, groceries, transportation, and recreational activities is critical for properly managing living expenses. Additionally, The Netherlands is all about living a good life. You will have excellent healthcare, a dependable public transportation system, and a safe and secure environment. Furthermore, International students who study in the Netherlands gain a diverse cultural experience. It's an opportunity to immerse yourself in Dutch culture, meander through historic cities, and participate in a variety of cultural activities and events.
